propositions: Phase 3 remediation proposers run without validating their proposals against project history or harm reachability, allowing reversals of recorded decisions and speculative harms to reach Phase 4 approval unflagged
Finding validity scoring uses 4 binary sub-questions but lacks a fifth check (harm_reachable) to require concrete triggering inputs or states that produce asserted harm

Two blind parallel proposers in Phase 3 read identical evidence and measure prompt stability rather than correctness; divergence on uncovered survivors needs asymmetric evidence sources and targeted research rounds

Findings whose remediation reverses a recorded deliberate decision lack a penalty or disclosure mechanism; prior_decision queries must surface evidence and apply -0.10 validity penalty only when no changed evidence is named
Plan items lack a way to flag findings reclassified as hardening (non-defect improvements) versus defects for the Phase 4 reviewer's awareness

Retired provenance vocabulary (oss-adopted, OSS-adopted, OSS-research tiebreak) must be replaced with research-resolved and no-consensus tags reflecting the new asymmetric proposer and divergence research semantics
